items.title: Flood-displaced Rasuwa students resume classes in Lalitpur
items.blurb: Hakubesi Basic School from Amachhodingmo Rural Municipality is now operating from the premises of Kitini Secondary School in Godawari.

items.title: Eleven sailors missing after drone sinks ship off Bulgaria
items.blurb: Bulgaria stopped short of explicitly accusing Russia of carrying out the attacks but Prime Minister Rumen Radev said their outcome“benefits the Russian Federation”.

items.title: Nepal, India discuss border security, transnational crime and disaster response
items.blurb: The two neighbours also seek closer coordination on disaster preparedness as floods and landslides threaten border communities, transport links and infrastructure.

items.title: Bailey bridge planned at flood-damaged Arughat crossing
items.blurb: A 22-metre section of the bridge was washed away by the Budhi Gandaki flood on Sunday, halting traffic between Gorkha and Dhading. Authorities aim to complete the temporary crossing within 10 days.

items.title: 14 internet providers fined for overcharging customers
items.blurb: The Nepal Telecommunications Authority has fined the companies Rs50,000 each, ordered the withdrawal of unauthorised packages and directed compensation for customers who suffered losses.

items.title: Budhigandaki flood victims struggle to find shelter
items.blurb: More than 200 homes were swept away in Gorkha, while destroyed bridges and trails have left northern settlements cut off from relief supplies.

items.title: Their flood videos went viral. They are still haunted by what they saw
items.blurb: Millions watched videos of the August 26 flood that devastated entire towns. The men behind two of the clips survived, but one lost his home and farmland, the other his mother.

items.title: Can Himalayan floods bridge the India-China divide?
items.blurb: When a few hours’ notice can save lives, fragmented or missing cross-country information becomes dangerous.

items.title: Budhigandaki flood: What the report says about the gap between local warnings and official records
items.blurb: A driver received a flood warning at 4:45am on Sunday and posted an alert on Facebook minutes later, while the disaster authority’s report says a landslide blocked the river at 5:30am.

items.title: Prithvi Highway’s Galaudi section to close overnight for repairs to damaged section
items.blurb: Traffic will be halted from 11pm Monday to 5am Tuesday at Galaudi in Dhading, where a section of the road subsided last week.

items.title: Flood cuts off two villages along Budhigandaki in Gorkha
items.blurb: The river has washed away foot trail connecting Jagat and Salleri, leaving residents, workers and more than 100 trekkers stranded.
